new_failures.finding: INT4 startswith("I") counts Is/In as the word I; FP8 checks the first whitespace-delimited word. Genuine word-boundary regression.
INT4 uses signed Python modulo without abs. On (-6,-9), returns 4 instead of 54. Genuine negative-input code regression; both pass the separate direct arithmetic/runtime canaries.
INT4 split(" ") preserves empty fields on repeated spaces and checks only literal spaces. FP8 split() collapses whitespace. Genuine string edge-case regression.
INT4 explicitly excludes bool while the oracle and FP8 include Python bool as int. Type/specification interpretation difference; retained as a failed test with no rescoring.
INT4 omits empty-b special case; zero rotations returns False for ("", ""). FP8 returns True. Genuine empty-input regression.

recovered.finding: INT4 indexes the sorted every-third subset correctly. FP8 indexes it with the full-list index and fails.
INT4 completes executable nested-bracket code. FP8 spends the 2048-token cap in comments and has no executable implementation after sanitization.
